history.summary: UNVERIFIED IDENTITY: this is a separate small Ganesha temple tucked into the Mullackal market/shopping area of Alappuzha town, with an imposing entrance between the shops; it is known mainly through traveller reviews (Tripadvisor Travellers' Choice listing) and place directories. It is distinct from the Ganesha sub-shrine inside the nearby Mullakkal Rajarajeswari Temple complex (seq 1721). Reviews describe beautiful, intricate, colourful architecture. name: Sree Ganesh Temple, Mullackal
town_description: Alappuzha (Alleppey) is a coastal city in Kerala known for its backwaters, houseboats and the Nehru Trophy boat race, often called the 'Venice of the East'. It is the district headquarters with rail links and the NH-66 coastal highway. The Sree Ganesh Temple stands in the busy Mullackal market area of the town, entered from the main road between shops.
